'user_row', (SELECT to_jsonb(u) || jsonb_build_object('teams', COALESCE(to_jsonb(u.teams), '[]'::jsonb),

 'team_row', (SELECT to_jsonb(t) || jsonb_build_object('admins', COALESCE(to_jsonb(t.admins), '[]'::jsonb),

    'blocked_tools', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.blocked_tools), '[]'::jsonb),
    'vector_stores', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.vector_stores), '[]'::jsonb),
    'agents', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.agents), '[]'::jsonb),
    'agent_access_groups', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.agent_access_groups), '[]'::jsonb),
    'models', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.models), '[]'::jsonb),
    'search_tools', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.search_tools), '[]'::jsonb),
    'skills', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.skills), '[]'::jsonb)) FROM "LiteLLM_ObjectPermissionTable" op WHERE op.object_permission_id = t.object_permission_id)) FROM "LiteLLM_TeamTable" t WHERE t.team_id=$2),
'membership_row', (SELECT to_jsonb(tm) || jsonb_build_object('litellm_budget_table', (SELECT to_jsonb(b) || jsonb_build_object('allowed_models', COALESCE(to_jsonb(b.allowed_models), '[]'::jsonb)) FROM "LiteLLM_BudgetTable" b WHERE b.budget_id = tm.budget_id)) FROM "LiteLLM_TeamMembership" tm WHERE tm.user_id=$3 AND tm.team_id=$2),
'organization_row', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) || jsonb_build_object('models', COALESCE(to_jsonb(o.models), '[]'::jsonb), 'litellm_budget_table', (SELECT to_jsonb(b) || jsonb_build_object('allowed_models', COALESCE(to_jsonb(b.allowed_models), '[]'::jsonb)) FROM "LiteLLM_BudgetTable" b WHERE b.budget_id = o.budget_id), 'object_permission', (SELECT to_jsonb(op) || jsonb_build_object('mcp_servers', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.mcp_servers), '[]'::jsonb),
    'mcp_access_groups', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.mcp_access_groups), '[]'::jsonb),

    'blocked_tools', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.blocked_tools), '[]'::jsonb),
    'vector_stores', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.vector_stores), '[]'::jsonb),
    'agents', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.agents), '[]'::jsonb),
    'agent_access_groups', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.agent_access_groups), '[]'::jsonb),
    'models', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.models), '[]'::jsonb),
    'search_tools', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.search_tools), '[]'::jsonb),
    'skills', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.skills), '[]'::jsonb)) FROM "LiteLLM_ObjectPermissionTable" op WHERE op.object_permission_id = o.object_permission_id)) FROM "LiteLLM_OrganizationTable" o WHERE o.organization_id=$4),
'project_row', (SELECT to_jsonb(p) || jsonb_build_object('models', COALESCE(to_jsonb(p.models), '[]'::jsonb), 'litellm_budget_table', (SELECT to_jsonb(b) || jsonb_build_object('allowed_models', COALESCE(to_jsonb(b.allowed_models), '[]'::jsonb)) FROM "LiteLLM_BudgetTable" b WHERE b.budget_id = p.budget_id), 'object_permission', (SELECT to_jsonb(op) || jsonb_build_object('mcp_servers', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.mcp_servers), '[]'::jsonb),
    'mcp_access_groups', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.mcp_access_groups), '[]'::jsonb),
    'mcp_toolsets', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.mcp_toolsets), '[]'::jsonb),
    'blocked_tools', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.blocked_tools), '[]'::jsonb),
    'vector_stores', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.vector_stores), '[]'::jsonb),
    'agents', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.agents), '[]'::jsonb),
    'agent_access_groups', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.agent_access_groups), '[]'::jsonb),
    'models', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.models), '[]'::jsonb),
    'search_tools', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.search_tools), '[]'::jsonb),
    'skills', COALESCE(to_jsonb(op.skills), '[]'::jsonb)) FROM "LiteLLM_ObjectPermissionTable" op WHERE op.object_permission_id = p.object_permission_id)) FROM "LiteLLM_ProjectTable" p WHERE p.project_id=$5)) AS "data!: AuthData"
